rules.process_window: inclusive interval from first to last primary-result sample
rules.lot2_date_correction: for Lot 2 only, Excel dates 2026-06-04 through 2026-12-04 are day/month swaps and map to 2026-04-06 through 2026-04-12
rules.same_second: arithmetic mean after removing raw 2.621 sentinel values
rules.massview_normalization: already normalized by the instrument; no additional temperature or pressure conversion
rules.zero_rule: leading and trailing zeros are valid; zeros between the first and last positive active-process observation are invalid
rules.edge_gap_rule: missing seconds before first acquisition and after last acquisition inside the sampling window are filled with explicit artificial zero flags; internal gaps are not imputed
rules.active_end_rule: first IMPOSTA_CTA event after 24 h with Modo=2 and TempMin=9 and TempMax=11; the event second belongs to postprocess/cooling
rules.executed_temperature_source: Sonda1; controller setpoint is retained as the commanded input
rules.co2_model_exclusion_reason: owner-confirmed poor Lot 1 signal; retain for QC but do not calibrate
rules.gc_preparation: 50 mL stock prepared; 10 mL transferred to analyst
rules.condensate_volume_source: 09_Aromas_Cond columns Vol CA (mL) and Vol CB (mL)
rules.gc_pairing_rule: 39 pilot wine MEF samples = 6 initial baselines without MIX + 33 samples paired one-to-one with the 33 MIX samples
rules.gc_interval_rule: each MIX is accumulated from the preceding collection, or from the first primary sample for MIX-01
rules.gc_censoring_rule: NQ and numeric below-LOQ values are retained as left-censored observations
rules.ethanol_negative_formula_artifact_rule: when raw Alcolyzer is blank and corrected value is -0.3 percent v/v, preserve original and set processed value to zero
rules.lot3_operational_reconstruction: owner confirmed identical operation to matching Lot 1 run; shift events by sampling-start offset
rules.modbus_26136: single non-blocking acquisition gap; do not impute
